scope: Five actually bound Skill programs and Ch’en alter mode/counter configuration; ordinary native/static inputs, no runtime or active XLua observation.

facts.privateHistory: Per-deployment spell count selects one of two Buff lists
facts.coreMinimum: Initial Sustain may select TIME or INFINITE; same Content program can select mode/effect.

facts.privateHistory: Per-deployment spell count selects finite/indefinite list and stronger effect operands
facts.coreMinimum: Initial Sustain selection plus explicit Content effect parameters; no separate callback identity requirement.

facts.budget: First TIME15 seconds, second and later TIME25 seconds
facts.privateHistory: Trigger-count predicate writes duration_plus from duration/enhance_duration and marks enhanced mode
facts.coreMinimum: Evaluated initial duration; same program handles mode/range/attack-pattern variation.

facts.budget: Instant/action-coupled Skill in selected table; duration0
facts.trigger: MANUAL is retained. After the fifth activation, Content creates a .03-second periodic TriggerSkill program.
facts.privateHistory: Cast-count/charge markers control attack selection and permanent enhanced state
facts.coreMinimum: Persistent Content automatic-attempt policy using existing manual activation; not proof of trigger enum mutation.

facts.budget: AMMO original base B is8 ordinarily or20 when fully charged, before independent max-count additions
facts.selection: Actual BuffDuringSkill installs the >=2-charge judge, then the effect selects Mode2/S2 or Mode3/S2+. Two AbilityEventCounters have useAnotherBBKey false/true and triggerTimeCount8/20.
facts.nativeConsumer: AbilityEventCounter.SetData#96414 writes chosen count to m_maxCount then copies it to m_originalMaxCount; independent contribution occupies m_maxAdditionCount.
facts.coreMinimum: Evaluate the base Sustain.AMMO amount for this activation before resolveCapacity. Do not replace a base20 selection with fixed addition12 while retaining base8.

assessment: The selected actual variations are initial sustain (TIME value, TIME/INFINITE, AMMO base value), effect/action stage operands, and an automatic-attempt policy. None supplies a group of changed initialization/progress/end/operation programs that would make complete Activation Definition replacement materially more natural than narrow evaluation; this is a bounded engineering assessment, not a Turing-completeness argument against separate definitions.
reusedAmmoEvidence: docs/research/evidence/skill-parameter-formulas-20261029/ammo-content.json and ammo-native.json: actual Inside/Lemuen fixed capacity additions and native aggregation; separate from these four initial-duration variations.
limits: Targeted representative cases are not exhaustive proof of absence.
Native object/class layout is not an architecture requirement.
Current installed Prefab and fixed mirror tables are separately versioned.
No production code or shared case changed.

communitySources.paraphrase: S2 has a finite first use and indefinite later uses, reset for each deployment.
S3 becomes stronger and indefinite from the second use, reset for each deployment.
S3 gains expanded range/three hits and a longer 25-second duration from its second use.
After the fifth use S3 is automatically attempted, while its underlying manual-trigger nature remains.
